column11: Kevin Obote is the Founder and Lead Machine Learning Engineer at Guild Code, a technology company building AI-driven solutions for Africa’s most pressing challenges in agriculture, mental health, and education, through platforms such as eLima, MentaCare, and Sema. column16: As the Lead of Evaluation of Datasets and a core member of the Evaluation Pipeline, my current project contribution centered on establishing a robust framework for assessing African language models. I personally drove the AfriDocMT Integration project, where I developed and implemented the custom YAML task configurations within the lm-evaluation-harness. This work is crucial for formally benchmarking sequence-to-sequence models, such as the NLLB-200, against the masakhane/AfriDocMT dataset, allowing us to measure translation quality across five African language pairs in both document-level and sentence-level contexts. Furthermore, my participation in the Model Research group ensures that these rigorous evaluation methodologies are directly integrated into the strategic selection and development of future models for the community.
